description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport containing static methods for selecting and applying gateway discovery configurations, such as preferred transport types and URL configurations, based on various gateway attributes.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL and transport preferences based on the discovered gateway info and current application state.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport type (direct or current) based on the gateway's attributes.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Decides if the direct transport should be preferred based on gateway URL and host suffix conditions.
